overview_description.description:
Spendflo is an AI-native procurement platform that helps fast-growing and enterprise companies bring structure, visibility, and control to how they buy and manage vendors. 
By orchestrating procurement workflows across finance, procurement, IT, and legal, Spendflo automates intake, approvals, renewals, and vendor management in one system. 
With built-in AI agents and deep integrations across ERP, CLM, and IT systems, Spendflo enables organizations to reduce maverick spend, improve compliance, and make every dollar count.

product.name: AI Procurement
product.description: An AI-driven procurement platform that manages intake, workflows, contracts, approvals, vendor data, and usage tracking to streamline SaaS purchasing.

product.name: Managed Procurement
product.description: A service where procurement experts handle sourcing, contract negotiation, renewals, audits, and spend optimization on behalf of clients.

product.name: SaaS Intelligence
product.description: A platform that provides real-time insights into SaaS spend, license usage, shadow IT, and user sentiment to optimize software budgets.

product.name: Dynamic License Management
product.description: An automated system that monitors SaaS license usage and enables license reclamation, downgrades, and optimization based on real-time data.

product.name: Procurement Orchestration
product.description: A workflow management tool that tracks procurement requests, approvals, SLAs, and audit logs to streamline procurement processes.
